crossRefs.note: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the…
But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

parallels.note: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

translations.web: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
translations.bsb: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
translations.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
translations.asv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.
